goal.en: Answer a coworker's phone and take a clear, correct message.
goal.zh: 幫同事接電話，記下清楚又正確的留言。

background: office desk with a desk phone with a blank display, a blank notepad and a pen, a closed laptop, a coffee mug, an empty office chair pushed back, a window with soft midday light

intro.en: Sam just went to get a coffee. Then the phone on his desk starts ringing, and it won't stop.
intro.zh: 山姆剛去倒咖啡。接著他桌上的電話響了起來，一直響個不停。

lines.zh: 喂？請問這是山姆的電話嗎？

choices.en: Yes, this is Sam's desk. Kai speaking. How can I help you?
choices.zh: 是的，這是山姆的座位，我是凱。有什麼可以幫您的嗎？
choices.tip: 接別人的電話，先確認對方沒打錯，再報上自己的名字：Kai speaking.。

choices.en: Hello? Yes, it is Sam's phone. But I'm not Sam. Who are you?
choices.zh: 喂？對，這是山姆的電話。但我不是山姆。你是誰？

lines.en: Who am I? I'm a client. Who are YOU?
lines.zh: 我是誰？我是客戶。那你又是誰？

story.en: The call starts with two people asking who the other one is. Neither of you is having a good morning.
story.zh: 這通電話的開頭，是兩個人互問對方是誰。你們兩個的早上都不太順。

fail.why: 「請問您是哪位？」直譯成 Who are you? 在電話裡很不禮貌。要說 May I ask who's calling?，或先報上自己的名字。

choices.en: Yeah, what's up? Sam's not here. What do you want?
choices.zh: 對啊，怎樣？山姆不在。你要幹嘛？

lines.en: "What do I want"? I want to talk to someone at Brightway, please.
lines.zh: 「我要幹嘛」？我想找 Brightway 的人說話，麻煩了。

story.en: The caller asks for your manager. Ms. Wong takes the call, and then takes you aside for a little chat.
story.zh: 對方要求找你的主管。王經理接了電話，接著把你叫到一旁小聊一下。

fail.why: What do you want? 很衝，像在趕人。接公司電話要說 How can I help you?。

lines.en: This is Robert Hughes from Lakeside Hotel. Is Sam there?
lines.zh: 我是湖畔飯店的休斯先生。山姆在嗎？

choices.en: I'm sorry, he's not available right now. May I take a message?
choices.zh: 不好意思，他現在不方便接電話。需要幫您留言嗎？
choices.tip: not available 是代接電話時最得體的說法，不必解釋對方去哪裡。

choices.en: Sorry, he's in the restroom. He drank too much coffee today.
choices.zh: 抱歉，他去廁所了。他今天喝了太多咖啡。

lines.en: Oh. Okay. That's... more than I needed to know.
lines.zh: 喔，好。這……超出我需要知道的範圍了。

story.en: Mr. Hughes tells the story at his next hotel meeting. Sam hears about it two weeks later and is not amused.
story.zh: 休斯先生在他飯店下次開會時講了這件事。山姆兩週後聽說了，一點都笑不出來。

fail.why: 代接電話時，不需要說同事去哪裡、在做什麼，那是同事的隱私。說 He's not available right now. May I take a message? 就好。

choices.en: Sorry, he is not at here now. You can leave message to me?
choices.zh: 抱歉，他現在不在這裡。你可以留言給我嗎？

lines.en: Sorry, can I what? Should I call back later?
lines.zh: 抱歉，我可以什麼？我要晚點再打嗎？

story.en: Mr. Hughes decides it's easier to call back. He calls three more times, and Sam is out every time.
story.zh: 休斯先生覺得乾脆晚點再打比較快。他又打了三次，山姆每次都剛好不在。

fail.why: here 前面不加 at：He's not here.；請對方留言要說 May I take a message? 或 Would you like to leave a message?。

lines.en: Yes, please. Tell him it's Robert Hughes, and our lobby lights are flickering again.
lines.zh: 好，麻煩了。跟他說我是休斯先生，我們大廳的燈又在閃了。

choices.en: Of course. Could you spell your last name for me, please?
choices.zh: 好的。可以請您拼一下您的姓氏嗎？
choices.tip: 聽到不熟悉的名字，一定要請對方拼出來：Could you spell that, please?。

choices.en: Of course. Sorry, your last name, how do you write it?
choices.zh: 好的。抱歉，您的姓氏要怎麼寫？

lines.en: How do I write it? Well... with a pen, usually.
lines.zh: 怎麼寫？嗯……通常是用筆寫。

story.en: You both laugh, but you never get the spelling. Sam later finds a note that says "Mr. Use called."
story.zh: 你們都笑了，但你還是沒問到拼法。山姆後來看到一張紙條寫著「Use 先生來電」。

fail.why: 「怎麼寫」直譯成 how do you write it 會讓人以為在問用什麼寫。英文要問拼法：Could you spell that, please?。

choices.en: Flickering? Have you tried turning the lights off and on again?
choices.zh: 在閃？您有試過把燈關掉再打開嗎？

lines.en: Yes, many times. That's why I'm calling Sam.
lines.zh: 試過了，很多次。所以我才打給山姆。

story.en: You spend ten minutes troubleshooting a lobby you've never seen. You forget to write down his name.
story.zh: 你花了十分鐘幫一個從沒看過的大廳排除故障，結果忘了記下他的名字。

fail.why: 代接電話的任務是把留言記清楚，不是自己處理問題。先問清楚名字：Could you spell your last name, please?。

lines.en: Sure. H-U-G-H-E-S. And my number is 555-0142.

choices.en: Let me read that back: Hughes, H-U-G-H-E-S, 555-0142. Is that correct?
choices.zh: 我跟您複述一次：Hughes，H-U-G-H-E-S，555-0142。這樣對嗎？
choices.tip: Let me read that back. 把名字和號碼複述一次，是避免記錯最簡單的方法。

choices.en: Okay, I have wrote it down already. I will let him to call you back soon.
choices.zh: 好，我已經寫下來了。我會讓他很快回電給您。

lines.en: Hmm, okay. You did get the number right, didn't you?
lines.zh: 嗯，好吧。你號碼有記對吧？

story.en: You wrote 555-0124. When Sam calls back, a pizza shop answers. At least he gets lunch.
story.zh: 你寫成了 555-0124。山姆回電時，接電話的是一家披薩店。至少他順便訂到了午餐。

fail.why: have 後面接過去分詞：I've written it down.；let 後面直接接原形動詞：I'll have him call you.。最重要的是複述確認：Let me read that back.。

choices.en: Got it, got it. No problem. Okay, bye bye.
choices.zh: 知道了、知道了。沒問題。好，掰掰。

story.en: You hang up before he can finish. You never learn what the urgent part was.
story.zh: 對方還沒說完你就掛了。你永遠不知道緊急的部分是什麼。

fail.why: 沒確認細節、也沒問還有沒有別的事就掛電話，很失禮。先複述：Let me read that back.，再問 Is that correct?。

lines.en: That's right. Please ask him to call me before three. It's urgent.
lines.zh: 對。請他三點前回電給我，這件事很急。

choices.en: I'll make sure he gets the message as soon as he's back. Thanks for calling.
choices.zh: 他一回來，我一定會把留言轉給他。謝謝您來電。
choices.tip: I'll make sure he gets the message. 讓對方安心，最後用 Thanks for calling. 結束通話。

choices.en: Okay. When he will come back, I will tell him call you before three.
choices.zh: 好。等他回來，我會跟他說三點前打給您。

lines.en: When will he come back? I don't know, you tell me.
lines.zh: 他什麼時候回來？我不知道啊，你告訴我。

story.en: Mr. Hughes thinks you asked him a question. The call ends in polite confusion on both sides.
story.zh: 休斯先生以為你在問他問題。這通電話在雙方禮貌的困惑中結束。

fail.why: when 引導的時間子句用現在式表示未來：When he comes back, I'll tell him to call you.。tell 後面要加 to：tell him to call。

choices.en: Sure. And while you're here, would you like to hear about our new lamps?
choices.zh: 好的。對了，既然您打來了，要不要聽聽我們的新款燈具？

lines.en: My lobby is flickering, and you're selling me more lamps?
lines.zh: 我們大廳的燈在閃，你還要賣我更多燈？

story.en: Mr. Hughes hangs up and calls Ms. Wong directly. The words "your new hire" come up more than once.
story.zh: 休斯先生掛斷後直接打給王經理。「你們那位新人」這幾個字出現了不只一次。

fail.why: 客戶打來反映問題時推銷新產品，時機非常不對。先讓對方安心：I'll make sure he gets the message.。

lines.en: Sam comes back with his coffee. You hand him a clear note: name, spelling, number, and "urgent, before 3."
lines.zh: 山姆端著咖啡回來了。你遞給他一張清楚的紙條：名字、拼法、電話，還有「急件，三點前」。

lines.en: Wow, the spelling and everything! Thanks, Kai. I'll call him right now.
lines.zh: 哇，連拼法都有！謝啦，凱。我現在馬上打給他。

story.en: Sam calls back at 1:15, and the lobby lights are fixed by four. Mr. Hughes even mentions "the helpful person who took my message."
story.zh: 山姆一點十五分回電，大廳的燈四點前就修好了。休斯先生還特別提到「那位幫我留言、很幫忙的人」。

notes.en: He's not available right now. May I take a message?
notes.zh: 他現在不方便接電話。需要幫您留言嗎？
notes.explain: 代接電話的標準說法。not available 不透露同事在做什麼，最得體；May I take a message? 主動提出幫忙留言。

example.en: I'm sorry, she's not available right now. May I take a message?
example.zh: 不好意思，她現在不方便接電話。需要幫您留言嗎？

notes.explain: 英文名字常常聽起來一樣、拼法不同，例如 Hughes 和 Hughs。聽到不確定的名字一定要請對方拼出來。

example.en: Sorry, could you spell your last name, please?
example.zh: 抱歉，可以請您拼一下您的姓氏嗎？

notes.explain: 把聽到的名字、電話、時間念一次給對方確認，是避免記錯最可靠的方法。最後加上 Is that correct?。

example.en: Let me read that back: Tuesday at 2 p.m., Room 305. Is that correct?
example.zh: 我複述一次：星期二下午兩點，305 室。這樣對嗎？

notes.zh: 請問您是哪位？（直譯陷阱）
notes.explain: 中文「請問您是哪位」很有禮貌，但直譯成 Who are you? 在英文電話裡聽起來很衝。要說 May I ask who's calling? 或 Who's calling, please?。

example.en: May I ask who's calling, please?

notes.zh: 代接電話，細節不用多說。
notes.explain: 在很多英語系職場，代接電話時不會說同事去廁所、在吃飯或還沒上班，只說 not available 或 away from the desk。說太多會讓同事尷尬，也不夠專業。

example.en: He's away from his desk at the moment.
